title: a custom-string option was copied by the option's value size, which counts a 4-byte PEN the string buffer does not hold
object: the custom option's string buffer, one direct allocation holding strlen+1 bytes
lifetime_ender: NONE -- the buffer is alive throughout. SPATIAL row.
shape: a copy sized by a length that counts a header field the source buffer does not contain
allocator_layer: the platform allocator itself: one direct allocation, no inner layer. wiretap does not use wmem.
fidelity: model consumer, real arithmetic: size = sizeof(uint32_t) + stringlen and the copy length are upstream's, quoted in PROVENANCE.md.
live_proof: absent at the pin: v4.6.8:wiretap/pcapng.c copies `stringlen` in put_nrb_option (`grep -c 'custom_stringval.string, stringlen'` = 2, the copy and the pointer bump). The pre-fix form, copying `size`, is at 381681583b^ and is absent from the pin. A fix-reversal.

native-fix-differential.oracle: the buggy arm's read crosses the allocation and the case's damage flag is set; the fixed arm's bound keeps it inside. The arms differ by the upstream fix, not by protection. ASan reports heap-buffer-overflow at the labelled probe on the buggy arm and is silent on the fixed arm -- keyed on heap-buffer-overflow, never on the string AddressSanitizer.

status: built 2026-10-08; native arms measured by runners/run-native.sh in the same commit. The platform arms are declared predictions.
nested_why: the crossed buffer came straight from the platform allocator with no inner layer between -- wiretap and wsutil do not use wmem -- so under this inventory's axis, WHO ALLOCATED THE OBJECT, this row is NOT nested.
distinguishing: the length is not off by an index error but by a FIELD: `size` covers the PEN plus the string because that is the option's value layout, and the PEN was already written separately -- so the copy reads sizeof(uint32_t) bytes beyond the string, of which 3 lie past its allocation once its NUL is counted.
